description: This file provides support for NVIDIA Tools Extension (NVTX) used in profiling, including functions for range marking, event marking, and context management, with fallback stub implementations if the NVTX library is not available.

classes.name: _NVTXStub
classes.description: Stub class providing fallback methods that raise RuntimeError if NVTX functions are not available.

methods.name: range_push
methods.description: Push a range onto a stack of nested range span, returning the depth.

methods.name: range_pop
methods.description: Pop a range off the stack of nested range spans.

methods.name: range_start
methods.description: Mark the start of a range with a message, returning a handle for cross-thread ranges.

methods.name: range_end
methods.description: Mark the end of a range given its handle.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Describe an instantaneous event with a message.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Context manager/decorator that pushes and pops an NVTX range.
